_purpose: PREREGISTRATION.md T51 (written 2026-10-05, before any run): how much scrap freezes in, against how slowly the new space cools. A 256 x 4 tube at lambda 1.25 opens by itself at g 1.25 until 90 % of its points are flat (d = 2) and no stretch of tube three or more columns long is left (no connected piece of points at d = 1 larger than eight; Amendments 1 and 2, the same day, before any run); copies of that sheet are cooled to g 0.25 over 0, 1000, 3000, 10000 and 30000 fair sweeps by equal factors per block of 250 (one fair sweep = N / 96 sweeps of the chain) and held 5,000 fair sweeps at 0.25. Replicas 60 to 63 of one seeded set of 80. Not exploratory.
